Chapter 6681: Ask The High Heaven For Permission First

Chapter 6681: Ask The High Heaven For Permission First

“What now?” Li Qiye asked.

“Continue onward.” The duo exchanged glances before answering.

“Very well, I’m afraid your plan will fail soon though.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Who knows until the last second?” Fiendish Ground disagreed.

“I do since the result is dependent on me.” Li Qiye said.

“Not even the high heaven can be so sure.” Evil Transformation added.

LI Qiye looked up and said: “I expected your move and shall determine the outcome.”

“Are you comparing yourself to the high heaven?” Fiendish Ground asked.

“No, I compare myself to no one and plus, I have no intention of becoming the high heaven.” Li Qiye answered earnestly.

No cultivator dared to compare themselves with the high heaven - the ultimate existence. Li Qiye, on the other hand, spoke as if comparing himself to the high heaven was insulting to his goal. Perhaps only a true immortal would make this claim.

“You have to ask for the high heaven’s permission first.” Fiendish Ground said.

“I permit, that is enough.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“You are overly confident, Fellow Daoist.” Evil Transformation said.

“It appears you two still want to try.” Li Qiye said.

“Of course since we’re already here.” Fiendish Ground said.

“An arrow cannot return once fired.” Li Qiye said.

The duo couldn’t be convinced so easily.

“No turning back.” Both said.

“Then go for it, we’ll see if your plan will come into fruition.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Good!” They shouted and changed lifespan into vitality, utilizing the oldest primordial runes to fortify their body.

A strand of vitality from a primordial immortal could benefit countless beings, let alone their actual lifespan.

The emerging primordial runes were as tough as could be. They seemed to have existed at the start of time, containing all powers and materials.

They attached to the astral forms and made it stronger than ever. Hammering noises could be heard during the process.

“Tribulation Vessel!” Fiendish Ground roared and summoned a lightning bolt. Its light could be seen anywhere.

Once people caught a closer look, they saw that it was a body with numerous tribulations within.

“It’s Sixth-sense Ancestor!” Dugu Yuan shouted.

However, Sixth-sense didn’t seem to be conscious. He seemed to be alive but was more of a puppet at this point.

“The tribulations from Calamities.” The other overlords observed the situation.

A while back, Sixth-sense acting as Fiendish Ground’s avatar had obtained the tribulations from Calamities and ran away.

Evil Transformation came closer and the two crushed Sixth-sense body together.

“Rumble!” The source bolt fell into their grasp and expanded through their body.

This could have been the high heaven’s wrath or something else. All in all, tiny tribulations appeared over everyone.

“Leading him down?” Li Qiye expected this development.

Oceans of lightning formed everywhere in space to everyone’s horror.
